entities.summary: Charles Phillip Richard Moth is a British Roman Catholic prelate who currently serves as Archbishop of Westminster, having served as Bishop of Arundel and Brighton from 2015 to 2025. Previously, he was Vicar General of the Archdiocese of Southwark from 2001 to 2009, and Bishop of the Forces from 2009 to 2015.
